name: Nikaidou Kaname
source:
Kaname is the student council president of the high school, who commutes to school. He is very intellectual and cool, and keeps a calm demeanor and a clear head, even though he has problems at home with his father, who is a busy doctor. He likes to do crossword puzzles as a hobby. He is the guitarist in the band.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/firstlive/firstlive.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
